Synopsis: The player encounters a group of kuo-toa, humanoid fish beings capable of creating gods just by imagining them. They're overzealous and easily duped, and are currently worshipping a murderous redcap they've mistaken for a god of murder. He's capitalising on the situation and very much enjoying the incredible power with which he's been invested. In this dialogue, we can deal with him as this great inscrutable power, or see through the situation and expose / do a deal with him. In all cases he's brash, offensive and generally gross.The all cap lines are BOOOAL in his fully powerful form.When we suddenly rever to lower caps, it's when we've forced him into his 'common' form.BOOOAL = Boo-AHHL (almost guttural)Kuo-Toa = Koo-oh-TO-ah Cluster Contexts: - UND_KuoToaGod_SpeakWithBOOOAL.json: You interrupt a kuo‑toa worship scene: Pooldripp the Zealous and his followers have manifested a "god" by sheer belief — a murderous redcap posing as BOOOAL (pronounced Boo‑AHHL). In its god‑form (rendered in all caps and accompanied by VFX), the redcap speaks as an inscrutable, demanding deity and pressures the priests for blood; when the cult’s faith falters the presence wavers and he visibly reverts to an ordinary, brash and gross redcap. The kuo‑toa are former mind‑flayer slaves and are easily duped, offering sacrifice and building temples to fuel the illusion. Off‑screen the redcap is clearly exploiting them for power and pleasure, so the player can expose him, make a deal, or kill him — the sample lines show those alternate outcomes. - UND_KuoToaGod_KuoToaMinion.json: A node that plays when the player tries to click on a praying kuotoa. They will either praise you as the Chosen of their madeup god, or make you a new made-up god.BOOOAL - Booh-ALMahkloompah - mak-LOOM-pah - UND_KuoToaGod_HighPriest.json: The Zealot is a Kuo Toa obsessed with his new god - you. You've slain the 'pretender' he was just as dedicated to only moments before, and he's transferred all that zealotry to you.Mahkloompah = ma-KLOOM-pa. - UND_MyconidSovereign.json: Main dialogue with creepy myconid sovereign. He wants you to kill some duergar that are left from when they attacked these mushroom creatures. Myconids are part of a "circle", kind of a hive mind. They speak in visions, with music - all telepathically. This should be otherworldly and slightly disturbing. - GOB_AbsoluteCultistAble.json: Human cultist watching the Goblin King perform the Speak With Dead spell. context: Off-screen: a band of kuo‑toa — former mind‑flayer thralls who can manifest gods by sheer, fervent belief — have been duped into worshipping a murderous redcap pretending to be a deity called BOOOAL (pronounced Boo‑AHHL). In his divine guise his speech appears in ALL CAPS and is accompanied by visual effects; when their faith falters the presence wavers and he visibly reverts to a common, brash redcap (lower‑case). The redcap is exploiting the kuo‑toa for blood, offerings and power, enjoying his con and willing to bargain or lash out when exposed. The sample lines illustrate several possible player choices (expose, strike a deal, or threaten/kill), but are only example outcomes.
